method: Each listed condition was taken off and, per scenario, the readings that could replace it were measured on the corpus reachability boards (65 boards, cast-only baseline, as scenario-audit-inert-gate.ts asks). Early boards are nearly uniform: institution delivery and politicization, stability, approval and protest each split on one or two boards; treasury never splits (every board holds far more than any bound written); unemployment is 'normal' on 63. A replacement that admits one stress board is a gate in name only, so the default is removal. A week left reading nothing gets a weight boost where one reads the state its story leans on, a counterpart geography gate where the story needs the other country's coast, a premise where its class needs one, and otherwise an explicit universal declaration (doctrine 6.2 rule 2) in its 'why'.
